content: Ona semalimali gomagweine sanau manudi
Ta Yesu ꞌieonedi wate, ꞌigwae, “Yaubada ꞌina loina gete nadigega: Gomagweine site sanau ꞌidi mayale siꞌewedi ga sitauya toai meꞌolotona sabi aesotena ꞌina ai sagalina ꞌina mai ꞌena manuna.
ꞌEdiyega site nima uwauwadi ta site nima sinasinapudi.
Touwauwao nidi ꞌidi mayale nigeya ꞌana bwasi ꞌana loeposeyana siꞌewaꞌewa,
ta esi taudi tosinasinapu nidi ma idi bwasi ꞌana loeposeyana siꞌewedi ꞌidi mayaleyao maꞌediyao.
“Ta toai meꞌolotona ꞌisoꞌisoꞌi, ꞌenega maiboꞌadi siyamwayamwana ga siꞌeno mwataya.
ꞌEnega niuniuwanaya ꞌebweu tomota ꞌibwau, ꞌigwae, ‘Toai nina niꞌatu gete ꞌimeema. Watoolo be taaesota.’
ꞌEnega gomagweine nidi maiboꞌadi sitoolo ga ꞌidi mayale sigibubudi.
ꞌEnega gomagweine nidi uwauwadi gosediyao ꞌediya sisida, sigwae, ‘Gosemao, mayale ꞌana bwasi tupwana wada ꞌebwaꞌema, manuna ꞌima mayale niꞌatu be sikwekweu.’
“Ta tosinasinapu nidi sigwae, ‘Nai nigeya ꞌima bwasi sawesawenaya be tupwana ꞌaꞌebwaꞌemi, ꞌenega ꞌomi watatauya toegimwaneyao ꞌediya be ꞌimi mayale ꞌadi bwasi wagimwanedi.’
“ꞌEnega sitauya sabi gimwane, ta toai ꞌiapwesama ga taudi niꞌatu sigibubunaya maꞌenao silugu ai masulina manuna, ga ꞌawa sigibodena.
Muliyega gosediyao gimwaneyega siilama ga sigwae, ‘ꞌInapwana, ꞌawa ꞌugigege be ꞌada luguwa.’
Ta ꞌidi ona ꞌieꞌisena, ꞌigwae, ‘ꞌOmi mali boda, nigeya yamwalamwalatonimi.’
“ꞌEnega ꞌilobwenemi be walomataꞌiꞌita, manuna ꞌasiyata nina, nai tuta nina yailailama nigeya wamwalamwalatoni.
ꞌInapwana ꞌina ꞌebwaya ꞌina toguinuwao ꞌediya
“Yaubada ꞌina loina wate nadigega ꞌeguma ꞌebweu ꞌinapwana ꞌiabe ꞌitatauya mali esenaya, ta ꞌina toguinuwao ꞌibwauyedima ta ꞌiloinedi be ꞌaene ꞌina ꞌebeloina sida ꞌitaꞌiꞌisi.

Ga ꞌebweu ꞌina mani ꞌina toguinuwa ꞌiꞌebwaꞌena ꞌana yau paibi analedi kina, ta tai ꞌeluwena tu analedi kina, ta tai ꞌetonina analedi kina, manuna ꞌina ꞌebwaya ꞌediya taudi ꞌebweuna ꞌebweuna ꞌidi waiwai nadigega, ga muliyega ꞌinapwana nina ꞌipilisinedi ga ꞌitauya.
“ꞌEnega tai nina tauna ma ina paibi analedi kina ꞌina ꞌinapwana ꞌina mani nina ꞌiꞌewedi ga ꞌediyega ꞌiepaisewaedi ga ꞌadi loeposeyana paibi analedi wate ꞌilobedi.
Tai ꞌeluwena wate nadigega ꞌina tu analedi kina nidi ꞌiepaisewaedi ga ꞌediyega ꞌina ꞌinapwana ꞌina mani ꞌana loeposeyana tu analedi wate ꞌilobena.
Ta tai ꞌetonina, tauna ma ina analedi kina, ꞌiꞌewedi ga baleꞌu ꞌitaina ga ꞌina ꞌinapwana ꞌina mani nina ꞌikwaiyena baleꞌu solanaya.
“ꞌEnega tuta dudulana mulinaya ꞌidi ꞌinapwana ꞌiilama ga ꞌienaidedi ꞌidi guinuwa ꞌadi eꞌisa manudi.

ꞌEnega tai nina ma ina paibi analedi kina ꞌimai ga ꞌana loeposeyana paibi analedi kina wate ꞌimeꞌedi ga ꞌigwae, ‘ꞌInapwana, paibi analedi kina ꞌuꞌebwaꞌeguya ga ꞌana loeposeyana paibi analedi kina wate yalobena, ga gete.’

“Ta ꞌinapwana nina ꞌigwae, ‘Boboꞌana, ꞌoyo togwaunuwa ꞌaiꞌaila ta palupaluna. Niꞌatu ꞌuetapewa yage gidalidi ꞌediyega, ꞌenega ꞌamu loina yage sinabwadi manudi yaꞌebwaꞌeyo, be wate ꞌigu ꞌebe gwausowala gete ꞌena ꞌuda miyami.’

“Muliyega tai ꞌeluwena ma ina tu analedi kina ꞌiapwesama ga ꞌana loeposeyana tu analedi kina wate ꞌimeꞌedi ta ꞌigwae, ‘ꞌInapwana, tu analedi kina ꞌuꞌebwaꞌeguya ga ꞌana loeposeyana tu analedi kina wate yalobena, ga gete.’

“ꞌEnega ꞌinapwana nina ꞌigwae, ‘Boboꞌana, ꞌoyo togwaunuwa ꞌaiꞌaila ta palupaluna. Niꞌatu ꞌuetapewa yage gidalidi ꞌediyega, ꞌenega ꞌamu loina yage sinabwadi manudi yaꞌebwaꞌeyo be ꞌoyo wate ꞌigu ꞌebe gwausowala gete ꞌena ꞌuda miyami.’
“ꞌEnega tai ꞌetonina ma ina analedi kina ꞌimai ta ꞌigwae, ‘ꞌInapwana, yamwalatonimuya ꞌaene ꞌoyo tai paꞌaliyo ta ꞌimu esaesa ꞌuꞌewaꞌewa mali tomota ꞌidi paisewa ꞌediyega,
ꞌenega yamatautemu ga ꞌimu analedi kina nina baleꞌu solanaya yakwaiyena, ga ꞌimu mani gete.’
“Ta ꞌinapwana ꞌiꞌenapaꞌalina, ꞌigwae, ‘Toguinuwa toꞌumaliyo ta logwautoyasa ꞌaleyo, ꞌumwalatonigu ꞌaene ꞌigu esaesa yaꞌewaꞌewa mali tomota ꞌidi paisewa ꞌediyega,
ꞌenega ꞌilobwenemu be ꞌigu mani nina banika ꞌena ꞌusaꞌu, be ꞌenega tuta nina yailama ma ꞌana loeposeyana yalobai!’
Ga ꞌina ꞌaliꞌeiyao ꞌediya ꞌigwae, ‘ꞌIgu analedi kina ꞌenega waꞌewadi be tai nina tauna loeposeyana sinabwana ꞌilobena ꞌenaya waꞌebwaꞌe.’
Manuna ꞌabo yaita ꞌana egueguyai ꞌiloeposeyanei, ꞌana loeposeyana wate ꞌida loba, be ꞌida sinabwa; ta ꞌeguma yaita nigeya ꞌiloeloeposeyane, toꞌase ꞌenaya ꞌimiyami ꞌenega maꞌetamo sida ꞌewayaule.
ꞌEnega ꞌina ꞌaliꞌeiyao ꞌiloinedi be toguinuwa toꞌumalina nina siula apwese ꞌatamanaya sena guguyoi ꞌenaya, be nada tomota ma idi ꞌelouya sidedoi ta siesalaꞌiꞌita maꞌenao.
Yesu me baleꞌu maiboꞌadi maꞌetamo ꞌiloinedi
“ꞌAboꞌagu Tomota Natuna, be maꞌetamo ma igu esaesa tuyayalina be ma igu aniloseyao ꞌamama be ꞌenega ꞌigu ꞌebemi esaesa ꞌena yamiyatowa sabi loina,
be ꞌebeloina baleꞌuya maiboꞌadi mataguya sida egogonedima be yaweyalidi ꞌatuwa sipi ꞌadi toꞌitaꞌiꞌita ꞌiweyalidi gota ꞌediyega,
be sipi yasaꞌu dumedumedi ꞌataiguya ta gota gegeumiguya,

be ꞌenega toloina ꞌaboꞌagu taudi ꞌataiguya yada eonadi be yada gwae, ‘ꞌOmi Tamagu ꞌina obobomega wada gwausowala, wamai be ꞌimi ꞌebeloina nina baleꞌu ꞌana mweluluwaꞌunu ꞌenega ꞌigibubunaya manumi wada ꞌewa.
Manuna ꞌomi lowa yabotanaya ta waeꞌenigu, ta wate tonaꞌagu ꞌiyapasaya ta bwasi waꞌebwaꞌegu, wate yaetoꞌuꞌumala ꞌimi ꞌasaya ta wabwauyeguya ꞌimi anuwaya,
ta wate nigeya ꞌagu ꞌoamamo ta waeꞌoamegu, ta wate yaleꞌoasaya ta waayausigu, wate deliya yamiyamiya ta waayausigu.’
“ꞌEnega topalupalu nidi ꞌeguya sida gwae, ‘ꞌInapwana, to tuta sana ꞌaꞌitemu ma ꞌamu botana ta ꞌaeꞌenimu? nai tonaꞌayo ꞌiyapasa ta bwasi ꞌaꞌebwaꞌemu?
nai ꞌuetoꞌuꞌumala ꞌima ꞌasaya ta ꞌabwauyemu ꞌima anuwaya? nai nigeya ꞌamu ꞌoamamo ta ꞌaeꞌoamemu?
nai ma ꞌamu leꞌoasa nai deliya ꞌumiyamiya ta ꞌaayausimu?’
“ꞌEnega yada ona ꞌediya be yada gwae, ‘Onaꞌaiꞌaila, ꞌeguma yaita ꞌoyo gosegwao gidalidi ꞌebweuna ꞌulemei, nate ꞌena ꞌaboꞌagu wate ꞌulemegu.’
“Ta taudi gegeumiguya simiyami yaeonadi, ‘ꞌOmi totoꞌumalimi wapilisinegu be watatauya kaiwe sabesabelulu atayana ꞌenaya, tauna Yaubada ꞌigibubuna Seitani ma ina bodao manudi,
manuna lowa ma ꞌagu botana ta nigeya wada eꞌenigu, wate tonaꞌagu ꞌiyapasaya ta nigeya ꞌebweu wate bwasi wada ꞌebwaꞌegu,
ta yamiya toꞌuꞌumala ꞌimi ꞌasaya ta nigeya wada bwauyegu ꞌimi anuwaya, be nigeya ꞌagu ꞌoamamo ta nigeya wada eꞌoamegu, wate yaleꞌoasaya ta wate deliya yamiyami ta nigeya wada ayausigu.’

“Muliyega taudi ona gete sida eꞌisa be sida gwae, ‘ꞌInapwana, to tuta ꞌaꞌitemu ma ꞌamu botana, nai tonaꞌayo ꞌiyapasa, nai ꞌuetoꞌuꞌumala, nai nigeya ꞌamu ꞌoamamo, nai ꞌuleꞌoasa, nai deliya ꞌumiyami, ta nigeya ꞌalemelemeyo?’
“Be yada eonadi, ‘Onaꞌaiꞌaila, tuta nidi ꞌediya ꞌabo tomota gidalidi getedi ꞌebweuna nigeya walemelemei, nate ꞌena nigeya walemelemegu.’
ꞌEnega taudi sida tauya ꞌelouya ataya ꞌenaya, ta topalupaludi esi yawasi ataya sida loba.”
